# Learning Roadmap

This roadmap presents the recommended learning sequence for the **R for Research and Data Analytics** course. Learners may complete the modules sequentially or select modules according to their research needs.

::: {.callout-note}
## How to Use This Roadmap

Start with the foundation modules if you are new to R or research data analysis. Move to the advanced modules when you already understand data cleaning, descriptive statistics, regression, visualization, and basic research reporting.
:::

## 1. Foundation Learning Path

| Module | Vietnamese Title | English Title | Main Output |
|---|---|---|---|
| Module 1 | Nhập môn R và quản lý dữ liệu nghiên cứu | Introduction to R and Research Data Management | Data Import and Diagnostic Report |
| Module 2 | Làm sạch và chuẩn bị dữ liệu | Data Cleaning and Preparation | Clean Dataset |
| Module 3 | Thống kê mô tả và so sánh nhóm | Descriptive Statistics and Group Comparisons | Descriptive and Group Comparison Report |
| Module 4 | Tương quan và hồi quy | Correlation and Regression Analysis | Regression Report |
| Module 5 | PLS-SEM bằng R | PLS-SEM with R | SEM Results Tables |
| Module 6 | Trực quan hóa dữ liệu và viết kết quả | Data Visualization and Results Reporting | Figure Set and Results Draft |

## 2. Advanced Analytics Learning Path

| Module | Vietnamese Title | English Title | Main Output |
|---|---|---|---|
| A1 | Chẩn đoán thống kê mô tả | Descriptive Diagnostics | Diagnostic Report |
| A2 | Hồi quy nâng cao | Advanced Regression | Academic Regression Tables |
| A3 | Hồi quy chính quy hóa | Ridge, LASSO, and Elastic Net | Prediction Model |
| A4 | SEM nâng cao | Advanced SEM | Measurement and Structural Model |
| A5 | Thống kê Bayes | Bayesian Statistics | Posterior Interpretation |
| A6 | Mô phỏng Monte Carlo | Monte Carlo Simulation | Simulation Report |
| A7 | Nghịch lý Simpson | Simpson's Paradox | Grouped Data Insight |
| A8 | Phân tích Likert nâng cao | Advanced Likert Analysis | Likert Visualization Report |
| A9 | Thư viện trực quan hóa | Visualization Gallery | Publication-ready Figures |
| A10 | Bộ công cụ nghiên cứu | Research Toolkit | Method Decision Framework |
| A11 | Phân tích tổng hợp | Meta-analysis | Forest and Funnel Plots |
| A12 | Phân tích trắc lượng thư mục | Bibliometric Analysis | Science Mapping Report |
| A13 | Thiết kế thí nghiệm và ANOVA | Experimental Design and ANOVA | ANOVA Report |
| A14 | Mô hình hỗn hợp và dữ liệu dọc | Mixed Models and Longitudinal Data | Longitudinal Model Report |
| A15 | Nghiên cứu tái lập và báo cáo học thuật | Reproducible Research | Quarto Research Report |

## 4. Suggested Pathways by Learner Type

### Lecturers and Instructors

Recommended sequence:

1. Module 1: Introduction to R and Data Management
2. Module 2: Data Cleaning and Preparation
3. Module 3: Descriptive Statistics and Group Comparisons
4. Module 6: Data Visualization and Reporting
5. A15: Reproducible Research

::: {.callout-tip}
## Best For Teaching

This pathway is suitable for lecturers who want to use R for classroom teaching, student projects, and research supervision.
:::

### Graduate Students and PhD Candidates

Recommended sequence:

1. Module 1 to Module 6
2. A2: Advanced Regression
3. A4: Advanced SEM
4. A11: Meta-analysis
5. A12: Bibliometric Analysis
6. A15: Reproducible Research

::: {.callout-tip}
## Best For Thesis and Publication

This pathway supports thesis writing, manuscript preparation, and publication-oriented research.
:::

### Applied Researchers

Recommended sequence:

1. Module 1 to Module 6
2. A1: Descriptive Diagnostics
3. A2: Advanced Regression
4. A6: Monte Carlo Simulation
5. A13: Experimental Design and ANOVA
6. A14: Mixed Models

::: {.callout-tip}
## Best For Research Projects

This pathway is useful for research teams working with field data, survey data, experimental data, or longitudinal datasets.
:::

### Data Analysts

Recommended sequence:

1. Module 1 to Module 4
2. Module 6
3. A2: Advanced Regression
4. A3: Ridge, LASSO, and Elastic Net
5. A9: Visualization Gallery
6. A15: Reproducible Research

::: {.callout-tip}
## Best For Analytics Practice

This pathway focuses on data preparation, modelling, prediction, visualization, and reproducible reporting.
:::

## 5. Case Study Integration

| Case Study | Focus | Recommended After |
|---|---|---|
| Case Study 1: UTAUT and PLS-SEM | Technology acceptance and SEM workflow | Module 5 |
| Case Study 2: CDIO Digital Assessment Adoption | Teacher–student comparison, visualization, and SEM | Module 6 and A4 |

## 6. Final Capstone

At the end of the course, learners should complete a final research analytics report that includes:

- Dataset overview
- Data cleaning summary
- Descriptive statistics
- Group comparison
- Regression model
- PLS-SEM or advanced model
- Publication-ready figures
- Academic-style results section
- Reproducible Quarto report

::: {.callout-success}
## Final Output

The recommended final product is:

`Final_Research_Analytics_Report.html`

This report should demonstrate that the learner can move from raw data to research interpretation and academic reporting.
:::
